focus_areas: Edge definition between wing and background.
Texture consistency of the hairy thorax.
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the transition between the butterfly's wing edge and the blurred background. AI models often struggle with fine, semi-transparent edges against complex backgrounds. Also, verify that the 'hairy' texture on the body does not look like smeared paint or noise. Ensure the open vocabulary detector correctly isolates the wings before boundary analysis.
image_description: A close-up macro shot of a brown butterfly, identified as a ringlet (Aphantopus hyperantus), resting on dry vegetation. The wings are held closed, displaying the ventral surface which is light brown with distinct white-ringed eyespots (ocelli) and faint banding. The body appears fuzzy/hairy and brown. Antennae are visible and appear clubbed at the tips.
